stocks.label: Ledger
stocks.subject: Ledger: motion on Add, banks in their own colours, accounts with an icon and place of their own. + turns its + and Add rises; the Name pop-up's dim fades in and its sheet rises from the foot instead of snapping; a category tapped pops and its subcategory row opens with its rounds one after another; All rises and brings its rounds in. Bank/Cash on Add, the account in the picker and Home's default card are outlined in the bank's own colour (Krungthai blue, Kasikorn green, Bangkok Bank royal blue, cash in its coin's). An account's sheet shows its mark big, its own colour first, icons to pick (its logo, a coin, money icons, any bank's logo), its place among the accounts with arrows, and Reset (own look, Cashew's order). Wallets gained Icon and Place columns (money.orderWallets, byPlace). On the sheet: Meals, Vacation, Restaraunts and Climbing got distinct colours, the banks' old Cashew colours cleared. Tests: test/wallet-look.test.mjs, test/ledger-motion-e2e.mjs (7 mutants red), ledger-namepop-e2e waits for the new rise. Asked: "Put an animation for when this opens when we click on one of the items etc", "Fix vacation meals etc to have a lil diff colour scheme", "Pressing + should also have a minimal animation and when clicking All", "Krungthai Kasikorn etc banks should follow their own colour scheme when highlighted", "Let me edit icon and position of stuff like banks and money and ofc reset it".

packing.label: Vacation
packing.subject: Vacation Groups = design A "Photo cards", and New group. The Groups list is a card per group made of its trips' photos (a trip with none drawn in its kind of place), its round face, trips and nights each with its icon, and New group at the end. A group's page opens on its trips' photos with the face over them (camera and Resize kept), the name with a pencil (rename on every trip, or delete with Undo), trips / nights / countries tiles, each trip a big photo card, and Add a trip. New group is a page: an optional photo, the name, every trip as a photo tile to tick (latest first), Make the group writes the name into the ticked trips' With; nothing is disabled, a missing name, a name in use or no trip ticked goes red. Logic in pack.js (groupNights, groupCountries, groupTaken, withName, groupJoin, groupRename, groupLeave, tripsLatest) with unit tests; drive.mjs drives the list, a group's page, Add a trip and the whole New group flow down to the sheet's column H. Asked: "Claude design these two pages and allow me to add more groups", then "A".
